# Draft:Battle Camp (TV series)__disambig_1

Battle Camp is an American reality game show released by Netflix in 2025 and hosted by former NFL football player Taylor Lewan. Players try to get their names not added to a spinning wheel in order to survive elimination.
Gameplay
Upon arrival, the players are divided into three teams: the Wolves, the Bears, and the Eagles. In every episode, players partake in a challenge, a punishment, and a vote. Depending on how well they do in these, they are either granted immunity from the wheel spin or placed on the wheel, putting them at risk of elimination.
The teams compete against one another in a challenge that tests their mental and physical strength. Every member of the winning team receives immunity from the upcoming elimination and their names cannot be added to the wheel. As for the losing team, each member has their name automatically put on the wheel, increasing their chances of going home.
The winning team puts the losing team in some sort of punishment. Whoever loses the punishment also get their names added to the wheel.
Players then vote for who they want to eliminate. The voted players' names are added to the wheel. After this, the host reveals the wheel to the players and spins it. The player whose name gets hit by the wheel is eliminated. The host could also eliminate two people at a time.
In the early episodes, eliminated players are replaced by reserve players who would compete in their place. Halfway through the show, replacement stops and players are consolidated into two teams, where the winning team doesnt receive immunity. Eventually, teams dissolve and players compete as individuals.
In the final episode, the remaining players do some of the previous challenges as a throwback to them. The winner is chosen by the wheel spin.
Contestants
Players consist of contestants from previous reality shows released by Netflix.
Production
Battle Camp was inspired by classic depictions of American summer camps in television and films like Dirty Dancing. But, because the competition was filmed during the summer when real-life American camps were in session, the production design team constructed it all from scratch on location in Mexico. Construction of the set took about six weeks.
